# AI Use Policy Generator

Free · Open source

Answer seven questions. Get a one-page AI use policy your team will read, plus everything you need to roll it out. About 15 minutes, start to finish.

At a glance

-   7 questions, about 5 minutes
-   6 ready-to-use documents
-   About 15 minutes start to finish
-   Tailored to your tools, industry and data
-   No setup needed

## Your team is already using AI. The question is how.

People paste client data into personal accounts because nobody told them not to. A 20-page policy won't fix that, because nobody reads it. A one-page policy with a named owner and a clear list of approved tools will.

## Seven questions. Six documents.

1.  01
    
    ### Run it
    
    Install it once, then run it in Claude. No other setup needed.
    
2.  02
    
    ### Answer seven questions
    
    Your industry, the AI tools in use today, the sensitive data you handle, who approves new tools, personal or company accounts, your biggest concerns, and the policies it must align with.
    
3.  03
    
    ### Get your kit
    
    Six documents, written for your company, ready to edit and send.
    

## The policy, and the rollout.

### AI Use Policy

One page. The rules for how your team uses AI tools.

### Approved Tools Register

The living list of approved tools. Change it without rewriting the policy.

### Vendor Assessment Checklist

Vet any new AI tool before your team adopts it.

### Quick Reference Card

A one-page cheat sheet to pin in Slack or Teams.

### Rollout Email

A draft announcement, ready to send from the policy owner.

### Briefing Notes

Talking points for a short team briefing.

Ready for ISO 42001 later? The same repository includes a gap assessment, a certification roadmap and policy templates.
